MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #12
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 24.5
   B. 49
   C. 8
   D. 7

2. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 6
   B. 1, 2, 3, 6
   C. 2, 4, 6
   D. 3, 6, 9

3. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.025
   B. 2.5
   C. 0.25
   D. 0.205

4. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x
   D. 6x + 2

5. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. Cannot tell
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/4

6. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/4
   C. 2/2
   D. Cannot tell

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 17
   C. 66
   D. 34

8. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 55
   C. 16
   D. 32

9. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 29
   C. 23.7
   D. 23

10. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15.6
   C. 15.7
   D. 15

11. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 1

12. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 75
   C. 30
   D. 40

13. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.7
   C. 31
   D. 31.6

14. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

15. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 31
   C. 1
   D. 1

16. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 8
   C. 5
   D. 4

17. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 30
   C. 21
   D. 42

18. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 3/4
   C. 2/3
   D. 1/2

19. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27.7
   C. 27.6
   D. 27

20. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.7
   C. 19.6
   D. 25

21. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 1

22. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 2
   D. 1

23. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x ≥ 0 only
   B. x < 5
   C. x = 5
   D. x > 5

24. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 7
   C. 13
   D. 15

25. Solve for x: x + 4 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 13
   D. 9

26. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 10

27. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 29
   C. 11
   D. 3

28. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 13
   C. 26
   D. 170

29. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 156
   C. 24
   D. 144

30. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 40

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
